raw_graphql_pull_request.body:
## Motivation and change

SANA-Video applies a BF16 depthwise 3×3 convolution followed by bias and GLU to large channel-last activations. The tested `[21, 13440, 30, 52]` activation materializes an approximately 840 MiB convolution intermediate. A complete CFG iteration contains 40 depthwise convolutions and 40 separate GLU kernels in the frozen baseline.

This PR fuses those operations in one Triton kernel. Four adjacent output rows reuse input loads. It preserves row-major FP32 FMA accumulation and the native BF16 convolution, bias and SiLU rounding boundaries. Dispatch uses the existing per-signature exactness gate and is restricted to SM120 inference with the supported large BF16 channel-last convolution. Unseen signatures during capture, unsupported convolution/layout settings, gradients, compilation and disabled cuDNN retain the reference path. A failed exactness verification disables the fusion. SANA-WM remains unchanged because its biased-convolution arithmetic differs.

The implementation lives in the KDA backend and is exposed through the existing lazy diffusion facade. This independent change does not include the separate eager-LN optimization. Existing RoPE and bias-SiLU fusions remain in place.

## Final-head benchmark

Frozen SGLang main: `af21e2b989e482cfdce39689126562f2209d53ac`. Final tested PR head: `f248594caca5c533c94612b6848ff3512ed98e08`. Frozen vLLM-Omni: `817d4c17feb702289a2d2b2cbacfd594c262b7a7`.
The [independent raw audit](https://github.com/BBuf/sglang/blob/cc6d5a134821364c9244a6aaea8a75dd0fe22558/evidence/preflight/sana-video-depthwise-final-primary1-raw-audit.json) checks every saved request, native MP4, runtime commit and GPU ownership sample and recomputes the original statistics. It does not change the frozen samples or thresholds.

One NVIDIA RTX PRO 6000 Blackwell Server Edition (SM120, 97,887 MiB, 600 W), GPU 0 only; GPU 1 idle. Checkpoint `Efficient-Large-Model/SANA-Video_2B_480p_diffusers@db5f398b13ca086d09a50ce156c20527773841b1`. Native SGLang and Omni backends; BF16 DiT/text encoder, FP32 VAE/noise/solver. Workload: 832×480, 81 frames at 16 fps, 50 steps, CFG 6, CPU seed 1101, empty negative prompt, 300-token cap, batch/concurrency 1.

| Configuration | Prompt | n | Mean / p50 / p95 E2E (s) | Serial req/s | Request peak GiB | Separate synchronized denoise / decode (s) |
|---|---|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|
| omni_eager | short | 6 | 85.2435 / 85.1708 / 85.4637 | 0.01173 | 31.011 | 81.1538 / 3.2919 (n=1) |
| omni_eager | long | 6 | 85.2417 / 85.1557 / 85.4571 | 0.01173 | 31.011 | 81.1240 / 3.2956 (n=1) |
| main_eager | short | 6 | 63.5638 / 63.5646 / 63.5718 | 0.01573 | 23.054 | 58.4761 / 5.0376 (n=4) |
| main_eager | long | 6 | 63.5655 / 63.5674 / 63.5722 | 0.01573 | 23.054 | 58.4810 / 5.0345 (n=2) |
| v1_eager | short | 12 | 61.3030 / 61.3000 / 61.3237 | 0.01631 | 23.025 | not collected here |
| v1_eager | long | 12 | 61.3000 / 61.2966 / 61.3201 | 0.01631 | 23.025 | not collected here |
| final_eager | short | 12 | 61.3031 / 61.3028 / 61.3103 | 0.01631 | 23.025 | 56.1882 / 5.0333 (n=4) |
| final_eager | long | 12 | 61.3054 / 61.3074 / 61.3156 | 0.01631 | 23.025 | 56.1962 / 5.0347 (n=2) |

Primary values use every predeclared measured request. NVML is sampled every 250 ms during requests; these are observed device-memory peaks, not exact allocator maxima. Denoise is from a separate synchronized diagnostic, not a component subtracted from primary E2E. V1 is retained for cleanup comparison. Omni denoise/decode reuses the already archived native stage diagnostic at the unchanged frozen source/checkpoint/configuration, with one steady request per English prompt. All primary E2E samples are new. Native stage boundaries differ across frameworks; no diagnostic timing replaces primary E2E.

| Prompt | Final mean E2E reduction vs main | Omni / final mean E2E | V1 → final mean latency change | Cleanup paired-t 95% regression upper bound |
|---|---:|---:|---:|---:|
| short | 3.55649% | 1.390525× | +0.00028% | 0.02661% |
| long | 3.55557% | 1.390443× | +0.00892% | 0.03643% |

| Comparison | Prompt | Process pairs | Paired median geometric ratio | Paired-log-t 95% interval |
|---|---|---:|---:|---:|
| main_vs_final | short | 2 | 1.036879 | [1.036786, 1.036973] |
| omni_vs_final | short | 2 | 1.391066 | [1.355012, 1.428079] |
| omni_vs_main | short | 2 | 1.341590 | [1.306936, 1.377162] |
| v1_vs_final_cleanup | short | 4 | 0.999996 | [0.999734, 1.000258] |
| main_vs_final | long | 2 | 1.036920 | [1.035395, 1.038448] |
| omni_vs_final | long | 2 | 1.391161 | [1.354252, 1.429074] |
| omni_vs_main | long | 2 | 1.341627 | [1.307958, 1.376164] |
| v1_vs_final_cleanup | long | 4 | 0.999892 | [0.999636, 1.000149] |

Intervals use process-pair log ratios, not requests as independent process replicates; only two main/final and Omni/final process pairs limit precision. Cleanup has four predeclared pairs. All original requests and warmups remain in raw evidence.

| Configuration | Cached launch-to-ready min / max (s) |
|---|---:|
| main_eager | 104.126 / 104.140 |
| v1_eager | 100.116 / 102.132 |
| final_eager | 100.105 / 102.126 |
| omni_eager | 26.014 / 28.016 |

These are cached process launches, not cold-start distributions. BCG capture/replay costs and quality transitions are reported separately; this depthwise fusion does not establish new BCG support or a BCG net win.

The prospectively frozen order is M–V1–F–O–V1–F–F–V1–O–F–V1–M, with one excluded warmup and three measured requests per English prompt per process. Prompt order reverses in the second half. Main/Omni have n=6 per prompt and V1/final n=12. HTTP E2E includes request submission, native polling where applicable, encoding and complete MP4 transfer, but excludes validation and disk writes. The primary SGLang process has no profiler, observer or added stage synchronization. All original samples and warmups are retained.

Fresh main A/A maximum noise was 0.03648137%. Cleanup mean regression must be no greater than this noise; the four-pair log-t 95% upper regression bound must also remain below 0.1%. The final table includes the complete paired results and uncertainty. Two main/final and Omni/final process pairs limit interval precision.

## Actual execution and compatibility

| Configuration | GPU kernels / CFG iteration | Kernel sum (ms) | Depthwise+GLU | Native depthwise | Separate GLU | Graph launches |
|---|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|
| main_eager | 2309 | 1170.332 | 0 | 40 | 40 | 0 |
| v1_eager | 2269 | 1124.244 | 40 | 0 | 0 | 0 |
| final_eager | 2269 | 1123.985 | 40 | 0 | 0 | 0 |
| main_bcg | 2103 | 1135.238 | 0 | 40 | 40 | 2 |
| final_bcg | 2063 | 1090.626 | 40 | 0 | 0 | 2 |

Profiles are separate synchronized diagnostics. CPU `ProfilerStep#3` launch correlations identify a complete CFG iteration and the actual kernels inside graph launches. The final eager path retains all 82 ATen LayerNorm calls; the existing BCG path uses its 82 fused LN calls. Both retain 40 RoPE and 40 bias-SiLU calls. Kernel sums are not primary serving latency.

| Configuration | Serving requests | Model replays | Serving captures | Warmup graph captures | Capture time sum (s) | Launch-to-ready (s) | Full diagnostic process peak (MiB) |
|---|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|
| main_eager | 12 | 0 | 0 | 0 | 0.000 | 106.139 | 22973 |
| final_eager | 13 | 0 | 0 | 0 | 0.000 | 112.139 | 22943 |
| main_bcg | 13 | 900 | 0 | 1 | 2.818 | 104.133 | 26355 |
| final_bcg | 13 | 900 | 0 | 1 | 2.766 | 102.116 | 26343 |

The compatibility sequence switches short/long/Chinese prompts and lossless/exact/high modes, including repeated requests and return to lossless. Exact/high use uncaptured quality-specific eager runners; returning to lossless reuses the graph without serving capture. Final BCG profiles place all 40 new depthwise+GLU kernels inside graph replay. These results establish compatibility with existing BCG, not a new beneficial BCG scenario. Full-process diagnostic memory includes loading, warmup, quality switching and profiling; it does not isolate serving-only BCG overhead. Launch/capture observations are cached individual runs, not cold-start distributions.

## Quality and actual generated results

All 96 final primary MP4s match their qualified native-arm reference hashes. The 51 compatibility MP4s match the same-quality main outputs, including every decoded frame. Native input auditing checks actual token IDs/masks, CPU noise and schedules. English cross-framework workloads pass the frozen quality criteria. Chinese cross-framework PSNR fails at frames 26–28 (minimum 23.5768 dB below 24 dB); its outputs and failure are retained and excluded from primary timing admission. Main/PR Chinese outputs remain exact.

Native SGLang main versus native Omni, with all 81 decoded frames evaluated per request. Frozen admission requires every frame to have SSIM ≥ 0.92 and PSNR ≥ 24 dB; passing an average alone is insufficient.

| Request | SSIM mean / minimum | PSNR mean / minimum (dB) | All-frame admission |
|---|---:|---:|---|
| 00-short | 0.956517 / 0.930914 | 30.7329 / 28.4207 | pass |
| 01-long | 0.962520 / 0.951014 | 30.9685 / 29.1087 | pass |
| 02-chinese | 0.939182 / 0.920909 | 26.7774 / 23.5768 | FAIL; excluded from primary timing |
| 03-short | 0.956517 / 0.930914 | 30.7329 / 28.4207 | pass |

The panels below show actual main/final frames 0/40/80 at 0/2.5/5 seconds with identical prompts and generation settings. Representative frames were manually reviewed; full-motion review is not claimed. Shared model artifacts remain visible: an extra teapot in the short prompt, two spouts in the long prompt, and malformed stacked lid/cup geometry in the Chinese prompt.

![Actual short main and PR frames](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/BBuf/sglang/cc6d5a134821364c9244a6aaea8a75dd0fe22558/media/short-main-vs-pr.png)

Original videos: [main](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/BBuf/sglang/cc6d5a134821364c9244a6aaea8a75dd0fe22558/media/videos/short-main.mp4) · [PR](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/BBuf/sglang/cc6d5a134821364c9244a6aaea8a75dd0fe22558/media/videos/short-pr.mp4).

![Actual long main and PR frames](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/BBuf/sglang/cc6d5a134821364c9244a6aaea8a75dd0fe22558/media/long-main-vs-pr.png)

Original videos: [main](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/BBuf/sglang/cc6d5a134821364c9244a6aaea8a75dd0fe22558/media/videos/long-main.mp4) · [PR](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/BBuf/sglang/cc6d5a134821364c9244a6aaea8a75dd0fe22558/media/videos/long-pr.mp4).

![Actual chinese main and PR frames](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/BBuf/sglang/cc6d5a134821364c9244a6aaea8a75dd0fe22558/media/chinese-main-vs-pr.png)

Original videos: [main](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/BBuf/sglang/cc6d5a134821364c9244a6aaea8a75dd0fe22558/media/videos/chinese-main.mp4) · [PR](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/BBuf/sglang/cc6d5a134821364c9244a6aaea8a75dd0fe22558/media/videos/chinese-pr.mp4).

The retained cross-framework failure is shown separately below: original main/Omni Chinese frames 26–28 at 1.625–1.750 seconds. Frame 27 is the worst PSNR sample. Differences in vessel contour, steam and cloth remain visible. These frames were exported with the original common decoder and checked against all 81 original frame hashes per video; no model was re-run.

![Retained Chinese cross-framework worst frames](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/BBuf/sglang/cc6d5a134821364c9244a6aaea8a75dd0fe22558/evidence/media/sana-video-native-cross-worst1/chinese-worst-frames.png)

Quality details: [all-frame metrics](https://github.com/BBuf/sglang/blob/cc6d5a134821364c9244a6aaea8a75dd0fe22558/evidence/preflight/sana-video-native-cross-quality1.json), [worst-frame provenance](https://github.com/BBuf/sglang/blob/cc6d5a134821364c9244a6aaea8a75dd0fe22558/evidence/media/sana-video-native-cross-worst1/manifest.json), [worst-frame visual review](https://github.com/BBuf/sglang/blob/cc6d5a134821364c9244a6aaea8a75dd0fe22558/evidence/media/sana-video-native-cross-worst1/visual-review.json). The initial local decoder failed the RGB-hash guard and produced no admitted media; its failure is retained.

## Cleanup, validation and reproduction

The complete five-file diff was reviewed against BBuf cleanup examples #42391, #40265 and #39293. Cleanup removes the unused row-count parameter, dead constant branches and redundant additions while preserving the accumulation/rounding order; tests extend the existing regression files. The scoped pre-commit checks and diff whitespace check passed. Final runtime validation passed 135 namespace/dispatch tests, 11 numerical/gate tests (six new cases) and an actual CPU fullgraph FX fallback check with changed inputs and bias. The CPU diagnostic does not establish compiled GPU performance, and local checks do not imply upstream GPU CI passed.

The first per-pixel fused kernels were slower, and five tested FMA orders failed exactness; these experiments remain archived. An initial qualification preparation failure occurred before GPU work and was preserved with its worktree-index repair. No failed or slower measurements were silently removed.

The candidate uses a separate RTX6000 checkout/branch. [All five changed files are registered](https://github.com/BBuf/sglang/blob/cc6d5a134821364c9244a6aaea8a75dd0fe22558/shared-file-registration.json) for cross-task coordination. A local virtual merge with main `de6c211a490588b542c42eee95b6610f0712f4ba` has no conflicts and preserves the exact changed content; [the merge receipt](https://github.com/BBuf/sglang/blob/cc6d5a134821364c9244a6aaea8a75dd0fe22558/evidence/preflight/sana-video-depthwise-main-merge-preflight2.json) records this source check. The merged tree was not benchmarked; all measured source SHAs above remain frozen.

Reproduction: [README](https://github.com/BBuf/sglang/blob/cc6d5a134821364c9244a6aaea8a75dd0fe22558/README.md), [frozen final sequence](https://github.com/BBuf/sglang/blob/cc6d5a134821364c9244a6aaea8a75dd0fe22558/evidence/plans/sana-video-depthwise-final-primary-cleanup1.json), [all raw launch/client records](https://github.com/BBuf/sglang/blob/cc6d5a134821364c9244a6aaea8a75dd0fe22558/evidence/block-runs), [final primary/cleanup admission](https://github.com/BBuf/sglang/blob/cc6d5a134821364c9244a6aaea8a75dd0fe22558/evidence/preflight/sana-video-depthwise-final-primary-cleanup1-admission.json), [compatibility](https://github.com/BBuf/sglang/blob/cc6d5a134821364c9244a6aaea8a75dd0fe22558/evidence/preflight/sana-video-depthwise-final-compatibility1-admission.json), [actual profiles](https://github.com/BBuf/sglang/blob/cc6d5a134821364c9244a6aaea8a75dd0fe22558/evidence/preflight/sana-video-depthwise-final-profile1.json), [runtime input audit](https://github.com/BBuf/sglang/blob/cc6d5a134821364c9244a6aaea8a75dd0fe22558/evidence/preflight/sana-video-runtime-input-audit1.json), [video identities](https://github.com/BBuf/sglang/blob/cc6d5a134821364c9244a6aaea8a75dd0fe22558/actual-main-pr-videos.json).

```bash
# Inside the pinned SGLang container, using the exact final worktree:
sh /task/launch_sgl_sana_video_depthwise_final_primary1.sh
# Host-side paired runner after restoring the documented prerequisites:
python3 /data/xyzhang/diffusion-rtx6000-20261026/run_sana_video_blocks1.py \
  /data/xyzhang/diffusion-rtx6000-20261026/sana-video-depthwise-final-primary-cleanup1.json
```

Stop the manual example server before starting the serial runner. The README records environment versions, image/local-wheel provenance, guards, archive hashes and media path mappings. Evidence lives in a separate branch; weights, traces and media are outside the production diff.

Scope is the native 480p, single-GPU workload above. Other resolutions, batch/concurrency, GPU generations, GPU compile and quantization are unrun. The frozen matrix retains 720p/I2V gaps, failures and slower cells; these measurements do not claim full-matrix dominance. Reported runtime evidence uses the frozen af21 baseline, not a re-run of subsequent common-runner changes.

The final table includes the complete paired results and uncertainty. Two main/final and Omni/final process pairs limit interval precision.

@@ -0,0 +1,156 @@
+# SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0
+"""Channels-last BF16 depthwise convolution with rounded bias and GLU."""
+
+import torch
+import triton
+import triton.language as tl
+
+from sglang.kernels.numerics import round_bf16_to_fp32
+
+
+@triton.jit
+def _depthwise_glu_kernel(
+    X,
+    W,
+    Bias,
+    Out,
+    N: tl.constexpr,
+    C: tl.constexpr,
+    H: tl.constexpr,
+    WIDTH: tl.constexpr,
+    BLOCK: tl.constexpr,
+):
+    offsets = tl.program_id(0).to(tl.int64) * BLOCK + tl.arange(0, BLOCK)
+    ht = tl.cdiv(H, 4)
+    mask = offsets < N * ht * WIDTH * C
+    channel = offsets % C
+    pixel = offsets // C
+    x = pixel % WIDTH
+    y = (pixel // WIDTH) % ht * 4
+    batch = pixel // (WIDTH * ht)
+    hidden0 = tl.full((BLOCK,), 0, tl.float32)
+    gate0 = tl.full((BLOCK,), 0, tl.float32)
+    hidden1 = tl.full((BLOCK,), 0, tl.float32)
+    gate1 = tl.full((BLOCK,), 0, tl.float32)
+    hidden2 = tl.full((BLOCK,), 0, tl.float32)
+    gate2 = tl.full((BLOCK,), 0, tl.float32)
+    hidden3 = tl.full((BLOCK,), 0, tl.float32)
+    gate3 = tl.full((BLOCK,), 0, tl.float32)
+    for row in tl.static_range(6):
+        for col in tl.static_range(3):
+            sy = y + row - 1
+            sx = x + col - 1
+            valid = mask & (sy >= 0) & (sy < H) & (sx >= 0) & (sx < WIDTH)
+            source = ((batch * H + sy) * WIDTH + sx) * (2 * C) + channel
+            a = tl.load(X + source, valid, other=0).to(tl.float32)
+            b = tl.load(X + source + C, valid, other=0).to(tl.float32)
+            if row < 3:
+                tap0 = row * 3 + col
+                wa0 = tl.load(W + channel * 9 + tap0, mask, other=0).to(tl.float32)
+                wb0 = tl.load(W + (channel + C) * 9 + tap0, mask, other=0).to(
+                    tl.float32
+                )
+                hidden0 = tl.fma(a, wa0, hidden0)
+                gate0 = tl.fma(b, wb0, gate0)
+            if row >= 1 and row < 4:
+                tap1 = (row - 1) * 3 + col
+                wa1 = tl.load(W + channel * 9 + tap1, mask, other=0).to(tl.float32)
+                wb1 = tl.load(W + (channel + C) * 9 + tap1, mask, other=0).to(
+                    tl.float32
+                )
+                hidden1 = tl.fma(a, wa1, hidden1)
+                gate1 = tl.fma(b, wb1, gate1)
+            if row >= 2 and row < 5:
+                tap2 = (row - 2) * 3 + col
+                wa2 = tl.load(W + channel * 9 + tap2, mask, other=0).to(tl.float32)
+                wb2 = tl.load(W + (channel + C) * 9 + tap2, mask, other=0).to(
+                    tl.float32
+                )
+                hidden2 = tl.fma(a, wa2, hidden2)
+                gate2 = tl.fma(b, wb2, gate2)
+            if row >= 3 and row < 6:
+                tap3 = (row - 3) * 3 + col
+                wa3 = tl.load(W + channel * 9 + tap3, mask, other=0).to(tl.float32)
+                wb3 = tl.load(W + (channel + C) * 9 + tap3, mask, other=0).to(
+                    tl.float32
+                )
+                hidden3 = tl.fma(a, wa3, hidden3)
+                gate3 = tl.fma(b, wb3, gate3)
+    bh = tl.load(Bias + channel, mask, other=0).to(tl.float32)
+    bg = tl.load(Bias + channel + C, mask, other=0).to(tl.float32)
+    hidden0 = round_bf16_to_fp32(round_bf16_to_fp32(hidden0) + bh)
+    gate0 = round_bf16_to_fp32(round_bf16_to_fp32(gate0) + bg)
+    gate0 = round_bf16_to_fp32(gate0 * tl.sigmoid(gate0))
+    dest0 = ((batch * H + y) * WIDTH + x) * C + channel
+    tl.store(Out + dest0, hidden0 * gate0, mask & (y < H))
+    hidden1 = round_bf16_to_fp32(round_bf16_to_fp32(hidden1) + bh)
+    gate1 = round_bf16_to_fp32(round_bf16_to_fp32(gate1) + bg)
+    gate1 = round_bf16_to_fp32(gate1 * tl.sigmoid(gate1))
+    dest1 = ((batch * H + y + 1) * WIDTH + x) * C + channel
+    tl.store(Out + dest1, hidden1 * gate1, mask & (y + 1 < H))
+    hidden2 = round_bf16_to_fp32(round_bf16_to_fp32(hidden2) + bh)
+    gate2 = round_bf16_to_fp32(round_bf16_to_fp32(gate2) + bg)
+    gate2 = round_bf16_to_fp32(gate2 * tl.sigmoid(gate2))
+    dest2 = ((batch * H + y + 2) * WIDTH + x) * C + channel
+    tl.store(Out + dest2, hidden2 * gate2, mask & (y + 2 < H))
+    hidden3 = round_bf16_to_fp32(round_bf16_to_fp32(hidden3) + bh)
+    gate3 = round_bf16_to_fp32(round_bf16_to_fp32(gate3) + bg)
+    gate3 = round_bf16_to_fp32(gate3 * tl.sigmoid(gate3))
+    dest3 = ((batch * H + y + 3) * WIDTH + x) * C + channel
+    tl.store(Out + dest3, hidden3 * gate3, mask & (y + 3 < H))
+
+
+def fused_depthwise_conv3x3_bias_glu(
+    x: torch.Tensor, weight: torch.Tensor, bias: torch.Tensor
+) -> torch.Tensor:
+    """Stride-one, padding-one depthwise 3x3 followed by BF16 bias/SiLU/GLU.
+
+    Each program reuses input rows for four adjacent output rows. The FP32
+    accumulators visit taps in row-major order, then preserve the existing
+    BF16 convolution, bias and SiLU materialization boundaries.
+    """
+    if not (
+        x.is_cuda
+        and torch.version.hip is None
+        and x.dtype is torch.bfloat16
+        and x.ndim == 4
+        and x.numel() > 0
+        and x.shape[1] % 2 == 0
+        and x.is_contiguous(memory_format=torch.channels_last)
+        and weight.shape == (x.shape[1], 1, 3, 3)
+        and weight.is_contiguous()
+        and weight.dtype == x.dtype
+        and weight.device == x.device
+        and bias is not None
+        and bias.shape == (x.shape[1],)
+        and bias.is_contiguous()
+        and bias.dtype == x.dtype
+        and bias.device == x.device
+    ):
+        raise ValueError(
+            "Expected channels-last BF16 CUDA input, depthwise 3x3 weight and channel bias"
+        )
+    n, dc, h, w = x.shape
+    out = torch.empty(
+        (n, dc // 2, h, w),
+        dtype=x.dtype,
+        device=x.device,
+        memory_format=torch.channels_last,
+    )
+    with torch.cuda.device(x.device):
+        _depthwise_glu_kernel[
+            (triton.cdiv(n * triton.cdiv(h, 4) * w * (dc // 2), 256),)
+        ](
+            x,
+            weight,
+            bias,
+            out,
+            n,
+            dc // 2,
+            h,
+            w,
+            256,
+            num_warps=4,
+            enable_fp_fusion=False,
+        )
+    return out

@@ -75,6 +75,14 @@ and FP8/NVFP4 producers can belong to the selected model or deployment path.
 The request `quality` tier neither selects nor disables those independent
 choices.
 
+SANA-Video's depthwise convolution/GLU fusion reuses input rows and avoids
+materializing the convolution output. It is enabled for large (`numel >= 2**24`)
+channels-last BF16 inputs with cuDNN enabled on SM120, after an exact comparison with the existing
+cuDNN convolution and rounded post-ops. Each shape/cuDNN-policy signature is
+verified before graph capture; an unverified capture or numerical mismatch uses
+the existing path. Autograd and `torch.compile` retain that path as well.
+SANA-WM uses a different convolution/bias rounding contract and is unchanged.
+
 SANA-Video's quality-gated linear-attention site keeps BF16 inputs for the
 first GEMM while requesting FP32 accumulation/output, then runs the second
 GEMM in FP32. The default path still promotes Q/K/V before both GEMMs.
@@ -167,6 +175,7 @@ Several norms look interchangeable and are not. Start here.
 | Entry point | Backend | Contract | Applies to |
 |---|---|---|---|
 | `bias_residual_add` | JIT CUDA | bit-exact `(y + bias[c]) + h` with aten's per-op bf16 rounding, for a conv that skipped its bias pass | channels_last-dense (`C % 8 == 0`) or NCHW/NCDHW contiguous (spatial `% 8 == 0`) bf16; `h` shares `y`'s layout (Qwen-Image 2.1 VAE residual blocks) |
+| `fused_depthwise_conv3x3_bias_glu` | KDA (Triton) | preserves separate BF16 convolution, bias, and SiLU rounding | channels-last BF16 CUDA depthwise 3x3, stride/padding one; SANA-Video inference on SM120, first-use verification per shape and cuDNN policy |
 | `residual_gate_add` | JIT CUDA (contiguous), Triton (transposed) | bit-exact `residual + update * gate` | contiguous tensors, or a transposed-dense `[B, tokens, hidden]` residual/output with contiguous update and row-broadcast gate (SANA-Video) |
 | `residual_gate_fp32` | Triton | separate FP32 multiply/add, then cast to input dtype | contiguous `[B,S,D]`, strided `[B or 1,1,D]` gate; Kandinsky6 |
 | `indexed_gate_bf16` / `indexed_gate_fp32` (`_` in place) | Triton | bit-exact vs `x + gate[idx] * other`: bf16 rounds the product, fp32 keeps a separate FP32 multiply/add | bf16 rows, per-row index into a `[n, D]` gate table (MiniMax-H3) |

+# -------------------------------------------------------------------------
+# SANA-Video -- depthwise convolution and rounded GLU
+# -------------------------------------------------------------------------
+
+
+requires_sana_video_depthwise = pytest.mark.skipif(
+    not (
+        torch.cuda.is_available()
+        and torch.version.hip is None
+        and torch.cuda.get_device_capability() == (12, 0)
+    ),
+    reason="SANA-Video depthwise fast path is enabled on SM120",
+)
+
+
+@requires_sana_video_depthwise
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("shape", [(2, 34, 1, 1), (2, 192, 7, 11), (21, 13440, 30, 52)])
+@torch.no_grad()
+def test_sana_video_depthwise_glu_rounding_and_row_tails(shape):
+    """Keep each BF16 rounding boundary and mask partial four-row tiles."""
+    from sglang.kernels.ops.diffusion import fused_depthwise_conv3x3_bias_glu
+
+    torch.manual_seed(606)
+    x = torch.randn(shape, device="cuda", dtype=torch.bfloat16).to(
+        memory_format=torch.channels_last
+    )
+    weight = torch.randn((shape[1], 1, 3, 3), device=x.device, dtype=x.dtype) * 0.1
+    bias = torch.randn(shape[1], device=x.device, dtype=x.dtype) * 0.1
+    raw = F.conv2d(x, weight, None, padding=1, groups=shape[1])
+    hidden, gate = (raw + bias[None, :, None, None]).chunk(2, dim=1)
+    actual = fused_depthwise_conv3x3_bias_glu(x, weight, bias)
+    assert torch.equal(actual, hidden * F.silu(gate))
+    assert actual.is_contiguous(memory_format=torch.channels_last)
+
+
+@requires_sana_video_depthwise
+@torch.no_grad()
+def test_sana_video_depthwise_gate_capture_and_changed_inputs(monkeypatch):
+    """Capture cannot verify; warmed replay must read current inputs and bias."""
+    from sglang.multimodal_gen.runtime.models.dits import sana_video
+
+    gate = BitExactFusionGate("test depthwise", per_signature=True)
+    monkeypatch.setattr(sana_video, "_SANA_VIDEO_DEPTHWISE_GLU", gate)
+    torch.manual_seed(606)
+    module = sana_video.GLUMBTempConv(32, 3).cuda().bfloat16()
+    module.conv_depth = (
+        nn.Conv2d(13440, 13440, 3, padding=1, groups=13440).cuda().bfloat16()
+    )
+    x = torch.randn((2, 13440, 30, 52), device="cuda", dtype=torch.bfloat16).to(
+        memory_format=torch.channels_last
+    )
+    expected = sana.sana_conv_bias_glu(module.conv_depth, x, allow_eager=True)
+    graph = torch.cuda.CUDAGraph()
+    with torch.cuda.graph(graph):
+        unverified = module._depthwise_glu(x)
+    graph.replay()
+    assert torch.equal(unverified, expected)
+    assert not gate.verified and not gate.disabled
+    assert torch.equal(module._depthwise_glu(x), expected)
+    assert gate.verified and not gate.disabled
+    graph = torch.cuda.CUDAGraph()
+    with torch.cuda.graph(graph):
+        actual = module._depthwise_glu(x)
+    x.add_(0.125)
+    module.conv_depth.bias.mul_(0.75)
+    graph.replay()
+    assert torch.equal(
+        actual, sana.sana_conv_bias_glu(module.conv_depth, x, allow_eager=True)
+    )
+    gate = BitExactFusionGate("test mismatch", per_signature=True)
+    monkeypatch.setattr(sana_video, "_SANA_VIDEO_DEPTHWISE_GLU", gate)
+    expected = sana.sana_conv_bias_glu(module.conv_depth, x, allow_eager=True)
+    with monkeypatch.context() as context:
+        context.setattr(
+            sana_video,
+            "fused_depthwise_conv3x3_bias_glu",
+            lambda *args: torch.zeros_like(expected),
+        )
+        assert torch.equal(module._depthwise_glu(x), expected)
+    assert gate.disabled
+    x.mul_(0.5)
+    assert torch.equal(
+        module._depthwise_glu(x),
+        sana.sana_conv_bias_glu(module.conv_depth, x, allow_eager=True),
+    )
+
+
+@requires_sana_video_depthwise
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("grad_enabled", [True, False])
+def test_sana_video_depthwise_reference_fallback(monkeypatch, grad_enabled):
+    from sglang.multimodal_gen.runtime.models.dits import sana_video
+
+    gate = BitExactFusionGate("test fallback", per_signature=True)
+    monkeypatch.setattr(sana_video, "_SANA_VIDEO_DEPTHWISE_GLU", gate)
+    torch.manual_seed(606)
+    module = sana_video.GLUMBTempConv(32, 3).cuda().bfloat16()
+    # Both shapes pass the size floor. Use two groups for the non-cuDNN path.
+    shape = (2, 13440, 30, 52) if grad_enabled else (1, 2, 4096, 2048)
+    module.conv_depth = (
+        nn.Conv2d(shape[1], shape[1], 3, padding=1, groups=shape[1]).cuda().bfloat16()
+    )
+    x = (
+        torch.randn(shape, device="cuda", dtype=torch.bfloat16)
+        .to(memory_format=torch.channels_last)
+        .requires_grad_(grad_enabled)
+    )
+    with (
+        torch.set_grad_enabled(grad_enabled),
+        torch.backends.cudnn.flags(enabled=grad_enabled),
+    ):
+        actual = module._depthwise_glu(x)
+        expected = sana.sana_conv_bias_glu(module.conv_depth, x, allow_eager=True)
+        assert torch.equal(actual, expected)
+        if grad_enabled:
+            actual_grad = torch.autograd.grad(actual.sum(), x)[0]
+            expected_grad = torch.autograd.grad(expected.sum(), x)[0]
+            assert torch.equal(actual_grad, expected_grad)
+    assert not gate.verified and not gate.disabled
+
